I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm or rule out the 8 April renewal date she overheard.

Nothing Pree has access to mentions Brackenwater Freight Co. There's no account folder, contract or CRM record in the shared files, and nothing in #central-team, where she posted. I checked only places she can see, and I didn't use the message search because it would show conversations she isn't part of.

In the reply, I suggested she keep the date marked as unverified until someone checks it against the signed contract or gets it in writing from Brackenwater. That's usually the account owner or the deal desk. I also told her I haven't written the date down anywhere as the renewal date.
